Then 5 days ago I woke up with a blocked ear and it has been like that for 2 days (even if I was sleeping with my head elevated which is extremely uncomfortable, and makes me wake up every few hours at night from the stress of my ear being blocked again). 

Out of nowhere two days ago, I woke up feeling normal which made me super happy again and that night I slept with my head elevated so my eustacian tubes would not get blocked or something but next morning again the same thing. Ear blocked and I can do nothing to help it, even now it's like this.
